purpose: Allow the already-frozen Study-C analysis to execute outside GitHub Actions when the exact source archive is locally available but the GitHub Actions cache transport is unavailable.
sequence_identity_opening_boundary: The executor verifies source bytes and may extract the archive after the external historical relation passes, but it does not execute nucleotide-identity empirical scoring until the exact survivor synthetic requalification passes and the one-shot authorization is created.
binding_verification: Compute canonical Git blob SHA-1 directly from each bound file byte sequence; no .git directory is required, so the same check works in a git archive snapshot.
offline_import_contract: Executor sets PYTHONPATH=<exact source bundle>/src and subprocess cwd=<exact source bundle root>; editable/package installation is not required.
chelsa_staging_validation: Before relation construction, require exact staged historical/current basename, order, byte size and SHA-256; historical resolved URLs must also match the response-blind staging manifest.
